status: reference-only-plan; full-head closure and projection consistency unproven

parts.name: temple
parts.shape: One shallow recessed patch outside the outer brow, from side of forehead to in front of ear; do not include eyeball or broad cheek.

parts.name: infraorbital
parts.shape: One narrow smooth saddle surface immediately under lower eyelid, inner end toward nasal side, outer end blending to malar cheek; no lid rim itself.

parts.name: nasolabial side
parts.shape: One small curved nasal-to-mouth side plane from beside nostril wing to above mouth corner, gentle nasolabial slope; exclude nose and lips themselves.

parts.name: nasal bridge
parts.shape: One narrow lengthwise bridge surface, includes the small upper glabellar transition, straight gently convex profile; do not include entire nose.

parts.name: nasal tip
parts.shape: One sculpted domed tip patch with distinct central projection and subtle split of alar transition; not a ball, nostril wings are separate.

parts.name: nasal ala
parts.shape: One anatomical LEFT nostril-wing crescent surface wrapping around the nostril opening, real curved underside return but open at nasal-floor interface; do not fill the nostril with a solid cap.

parts.name: columella and nasal floor
parts.shape: One very small central strip from underside of nasal tip down the nasal septum, then slight outward paired floor edges beneath nostrils; show underside clearly. It is not a whole nose or closed nostril plug.

parts.name: upper lip
parts.shape: Only the thin neutral closed upper lip vermilion strip. Its lower edge is the mouth contact seam. Exclude lower lip and philtrum. Tiny cupid's bow, no smile.

parts.name: philtrum
parts.shape: Only the small skin surface between nose base and upper lip, with central shallow groove and two gentle columns; no nose or lip included.

parts.name: mouth corner
parts.shape: One tiny anatomical LEFT commissure surface that receives the two closed lip edges and transitions outward into cheek; a gently folded surface, no entire mouth, no triangular black hole.

parts.name: inner eye corner
parts.shape: One tiny anatomical LEFT medial canthus with small tear-caruncle mound and fold; two eyelid rim endpoints attach to it. No whole eye or outer corner. Nongory gray modelmaking surface.

parts.name: eyeball body
parts.shape: One smooth near-spherical scleral body with slightly raised front corneal seat, isolated non-gory modelmaking part; no iris/pupil painted on this type because E02 is separate.

parts.name: iris and pupil cap
parts.shape: One small shallow curved circular iris/pupil optical cap fitting the E01 front seat, gray-blue iris and centered dark pupil as surface appearance, not a flat portrait or giant protruding button. Show actual shallow profile/back attachment.

parts.name: eyebrow strip
parts.shape: One slim curved anatomical LEFT brow hair strip, natural taper at outer end and broader inner root. Silver-gray short fibers follow the canonical brow. Not a rigid thick eyebrow block.

parts.name: upper eyelid
parts.shape: One anatomical LEFT curved thin upper eyelid surface, arcs over the eyeball with a narrow free lid margin and gentle fold back to brow skin. No eyeball or lower lid built into the detached part. Show concave eyeball-facing reverse, do not make a flat arch.

parts.name: lower eyelid
parts.shape: One anatomical LEFT shallower lower eyelid ribbon, narrow curved rim above and soft skin transition below; includes the outer canthal transition where it meets E03, but medial canthus E05 remains separate. Show inner concavity and tapering corners.

parts.name: front scalp
parts.shape: One shallow compound curved band just behind canonical forehead hairline up to front crown; follows actual skull ellipsoid, no spikes or hair strands, no whole helmet.

parts.name: crown scalp
parts.shape: One smooth top crown patch on the same skull, front/back and side cut edges correspond to S01/S05/S-SIDE, no complete hemisphere or generic ball.

parts.name: side scalp
parts.shape: One anatomical LEFT side skull curved patch above and behind the ear with a genuine ear-root notch. Not a flat plate; no full ear or hair attached.

parts.name: rear scalp
parts.shape: One broad shallow curved occipital patch on back of the same skull, tapering toward nape, with side and crown boundaries. No entire head or neck.

parts.name: helix rim
parts.shape: One anatomical LEFT ear outer helical rim as a slender smoothly curved rolled surface strip, open at lower end. No inner fork or ear bowl included.

parts.name: antihelix fork
parts.shape: One anatomical LEFT ear inner Y-shaped soft ridge surface with two small upper crura; no external ear outline, not a rigid fork rod.

parts.name: earlobe
parts.shape: One small soft anatomical LEFT lower ear lobe patch with front/back rounded transition and root attachment, not a sphere, no entire ear.

parts.name: concha bowl
parts.shape: One anatomical LEFT ear shallow irregular conchal bowl surface, gently concave with defined attachment boundary, no helix or tragus. Small auditory canal mouth remains a recessed opening not a through-head hole.

parts.name: tragus flap
parts.shape: One tiny anatomical LEFT curved tragus flap with subtle convex outward face and concave ear-facing reverse; no bowl or full ear.

parts.name: rear ear and root
parts.shape: One anatomical LEFT posterior auricular surface joining the back of the ear rim/lobe to the head, including the visible postauricular groove. A gently folded thin saddle, not a full ear or a solid wedge.

parts.name: front neck transition
parts.shape: One front half of curved neck skin extending from beneath jaw/chin to collar cut, includes gentle throat plane and curved side edges. No shirt/collar, no whole head, no disconnected cylinder.

parts.name: rear neck transition
parts.shape: One rear half of neck skin from occiput/ear roots to collar cut, subtle central nape hollow and side bulges; actual counterpart to N01 with side joins. No hair/collar or solid neck plug.

parts.name: raised swept forelock
parts.shape: One cohesive tapered silver-gray hair lock with lifted root and pronounced lateral bend sweeping from person's LEFT(+X) toward person's RIGHT(-X); one small shape family repeated six times, not full hairstyle. Root broad, tip feathered with modest sparse strand ridges.

parts.name: shallow top overlap
parts.shape: One broad low shallow curved silver-gray lock which lies close to crown, same dominant sweep, thinner rise than HT01 and smooth tapered overlapping edge. Not scaled copy of tall forelock.

parts.name: short side fall
parts.shape: One short narrow silver-gray hair clump that curves down along side scalp. Low relief curved root, tapered tip, not a spike or braid; show anatomical LEFT example, mirror with local fitting on right.

parts.name: ear-edge taper
parts.shape: One very short tightly tapered silver-gray terminal lock by upper ear/sideburn, small curved root and soft point; distinct from long side fall.

parts.name: posterior crown flow
parts.shape: One silver-gray curved tapered lock following a longer posterior crown arc with small S twist toward back. Not a curled ring or tubular rope.

parts.name: nape taper
parts.shape: One narrow short downward silver-gray terminal lock hugging nape with a small outward tip; forms irregular staggered nape edge through four placed instances, not a whole neck fringe.

generationPolicy: one initial image per sheet, at most one targeted correction for a concrete defect; unresolved remains unresolved
